Create one production-quality sprite sheet for a looping RUNNING animation of the same existing fantasy rider-and-horse character shown in the local reference asset rider3_run.png.

Visual style constraints:
- High-resolution painterly fantasy racing sprite, close to a polished game asset.
- Consistent lighting and color palette across all 12 frames.
- The output should be easy to split into 12 PNG frames and assemble into a seamless GIF.

- Keep empty margin around the character in every cell.
